def: A model trained only to predict the next token over a very large text corpus, which continues text rather than following instructions.
A base model further trained on conversations and human preferences so that it treats input as a request and replies helpfully.
A model trained, largely by reinforcement learning on checkable problems, to produce long intermediate reasoning before its final answer.
The first and most expensive training stage, in which a model learns to predict the next token over trillions of tokens of text.
All training after pretraining, including supervised fine-tuning, preference learning, reinforcement learning and distillation.
Continuing training on examples of the desired behaviour, such as conversations, using the same next-token loss as pretraining.
The fixed text format of role markers and separators that turns a conversation into the token sequence a chat model was trained on.
Running a trained model to produce answers for users, as opposed to training it.
